balanced.title: Public software delivery • balanced mandate
balanced.goal: Allocate a public software improvement mandate, schedule shared engineering and verification capacity, and produce an attributable delivery brief.
balanced.provenance: Synthetic operational planning case. Costs, risk scores, durations and benefits are supplied assumptions, not measured savings or production outcomes.

evidence.title: Unified integration platform planning assumption
evidence.text: The proposed unified platform costs six staff-days. The planning estimate is 1,400 weekly handling minutes avoided; integration concentration gives it four risk points.

evidence.title: Contract regression harness planning assumption
evidence.text: The contract regression harness costs five staff-days. Its planning estimate is 1,100 weekly handling minutes avoided with two risk points. Acceptance requires all supplied regression cases to pass.

evidence.title: API compatibility catalog planning assumption
evidence.text: The API compatibility catalog costs five staff-days. Its planning estimate is 1,100 weekly handling minutes avoided with two risk points. Public API fixtures are the only approved inputs.

evidence.title: Release telemetry dashboard planning assumption
evidence.text: The dashboard costs four staff-days for an estimated 600 weekly handling minutes avoided. Three risk points reflect unmeasured operator adoption.

evidence.title: Executable operator documentation planning assumption
evidence.text: Executable documentation costs three staff-days. The planning estimate is 450 weekly handling minutes avoided and one risk point. Actual time savings require subsequent measurement.

evidence.title: Legacy migration assistant planning assumption
evidence.text: The migration assistant costs seven staff-days and seven risk points for an estimated 1,500 weekly handling minutes avoided. It exceeds the base mandate risk cap and is not eligible there.
